title: Lab - Filesystem features and mount options
description: Mount with restrictions and prove they apply.
scenario: Mount with restrictions and prove they apply. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - noexec
tasks.instructions: Remount /data with noexec and try to run a script from it.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Read-only
tasks.instructions: Remount it read-only and try to touch a file.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Persist
tasks.instructions: Make noexec,nosuid the permanent options in fstab.
tasks.solution: # edit the options field to defaults,noexec,nosuid
